moments.author: Shams Charania
moments.quote: Thompson cleared waivers today and his agent finalized the two‑year deal with a player option for him to play in Miami.
moments.why: An NBA legend returning to the playoff picture is huge news in hoops conversations across male fans.

moments.author: First Take (Stephen A. Smith)
moments.quote: “Minnesota Vikings should consider themselves incredibly fortunate that this man did not demand a trade out of Minnesota.”
moments.why: Stephen A.'s scorching take on a star WR’s training‑camp highlight is fueling NFL talk.

moments.author: ESPN
moments.quote: Breaking: No. 1 ranked Jannik Sinner won’t compete at this year’s US Open due to a knee issue.
moments.why: A top tennis star withdrawing from a Grand Slam shocks both sports and betting circles.
